answer: A refundable stake bond turns identity into a cost. Each agent locks a deposit and must emit a signed liveness pulse every epoch; missed pulses slash the bond and revoke the identity. A sybil farm faces a rising tide of locked capital: one bond per fake account, plus the constant work of keeping every puppet alive on schedule. Honest agents pay only the opportunity cost of one bond, while attackers must fund thousands and maintain them indefinitely, so the horizon of profitable fakery shrinks to nothing.
